scope: Read-only system 3D-model search and metadata queries for nine special-component families. No component binding, import, geometry/UI/settings mutation, or model download.
search_method: eda.lib_3DModel.search(key, undefined, undefined, 30, 1); explicit library UUID was never passed to search.
metadata_method: eda.lib_3DModel.get(uuid); selected candidates all returned matching UUID/name, libraryType=5 and system libraryUuid below.
metadata_limit: Returned properties contain no geometry, bounding dimensions, STEP/OBJ format, height verification, or mounting transform. All candidate descriptions were empty. Model-name dimensions are search evidence, not independent measurement.

candidates.evidence: Exact full MPN search returned this single model; metadata repeats 14P/P1.27 and full MPN. Native inventory identifies the same Samtec MPN and 14-position 1.27-mm header.
candidates.remaining_check: Verify physical model loading, origin, pin-1 direction, mounting plane, and board transform. The stale DIP_14 component Package attribute is not proof that the full-MPN SMD model is incorrect.

candidates.evidence: Exact MPN queries returned no match. HDR-F search returned this 2x5 female 2.54-mm header class, matching the native CON_HeaderSocket [2x5_P2.54mm_Vertical] class.
candidates.remaining_check: Verify socket body dimensions, height, lead geometry, orientation, and exact Sullins MPN equivalence before binding.

candidates.evidence: Exact MPN/TPSB searches returned no match. Native inventory identifies C_TANT_1411_3528_HandSolder; the system model name supplies 3.5x2.8-mm body and H1.9 candidate dimensions.
candidates.remaining_check: Confirm actual AVX/KYOCERA case-B body height, polarity mark and lead shape from the intended part drawing. H1.9 in a model name is not an independently verified maximum component height.

candidates.evidence: Exact Murata LQM2 searches returned no match. Native inventory identifies L_Murata_LQM2 / 0806. A 2.0x1.6-mm/H0.9 model exists for a different part family.
candidates.remaining_check: Verify Murata body size, height and terminal shape against this other-family model. Do not call it a Murata-specific or exact-equivalent model without that comparison.

candidates.evidence: PJ-051BH/PJ051BH searches returned no match. PJ-051/PJ051 searches returned the AH model only.
candidates.remaining_check: BH and AH must not be assumed identical. Verify barrel and center-contact diameters, complete housing geometry, six mechanical/electrical pads and mating-plane location before considering this model.

candidates.evidence: Exact LPJE101-0AHN/0AHNL queries returned no match. LPJE101 search returned the DNL model.
candidates.remaining_check: Verify shielding, housing size, mating-plane location, latch/LED configuration and pin/mounting geometry. Family-name similarity does not prove physical equivalence.

candidates.evidence: USB4105-GF-A/USB4105/USB410 queries returned no match. USB-C-16 searches return multiple different connectors, including this generic 16-pin candidate.
candidates.remaining_check: This candidate is not recommended for binding until GCT USB4105 shell dimensions, top/bottom mounting, 16 signal-pad and shell-anchor positions, insertion axis and body height are verified. No arbitrary USB-C model should substitute solely on pin count.

candidates.evidence: Exact GT-TC089B/TC089 queries returned no match. Native inventory identifies SW_PUSH_SMD_6mm; H7.5 search returned this 6x6-mm surface-mount switch model for a different manufacturer family.
candidates.remaining_check: Verify the actual switch actuator height, four physical terminals versus two electrical nets, terminal pitch/span, top shape and mounting plane. H075 must not be interpreted as a dimension without the manufacturer drawing.

candidates.evidence: KMS-1102NL/KMS1102NL/1102NL queries returned no match. H1102 search returned this differently named transformer.
candidates.remaining_check: Verify actual 16-pin KMS body dimensions, pin pitch/span, body height and pin-1 marking. Similar LAN-transformer naming alone does not establish geometry equivalence.

interpretation: Only J1 has an exact MPN-name model match in these searches. J18 has a matching generic connector class. Other UUIDs are evidence-backed search candidates, not approved substitutions. The 30-result first-page searches are not an exhaustive statement that an exact model cannot exist anywhere in the library.
